FINAL: Hartford gate kiosk incident, 3 Aug 2026, finished for Ruth Calloway (Vantorre, Hartford plant; times as shown in the incident channel, company time UTC-5)

- First report, 10:42 AM: both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. The guard logged trailers manually on a clipboard in the meantime.
- Kiosk 1 back, 11:03 AM: the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working, 11:07 AM. The incident was kept open for another arrival cycle.

Other points:
- Appointment scheduling kept working from the dispatch office. Only gate check-in was affected.
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt, our hosting vendor) was checking the Hartford gateway route. No root cause has been recorded in the channel.
- Mateo's status-page access issue (login denied) is separate and is tracked in INC-4821. His admin account could open Pemberline Dock.
